items.title: What Is Moderna (MRNA) Answering As FDA Vaccine Betting Markets Grow?
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) faces fresh regulatory questions as prediction markets start trading on FDA timelines for its melanoma vaccine. Platforms such as Kalshi and Polymarket have introduced contracts that pay out based on when or whether the treatment secures FDA approval. Regulators and biotech firms now confront potential insider trading and information leakage issues linked to these vaccine approval betting markets.
